title: Land revenue systems: Munro, Andhra, effects

items.what: Military cadet, Madras; Mysore wars till **1792**

boxes.title: Munro in Rayalaseema
items: Chose it: ==no strong zamindars==; disliked strengthening palegars
About **80** palegars resisted; suppression took **18** months; abolished **auctions**
Advances for seed, implements; **1802** drought: repaired tanks without orders
Spoke **Telugu**, no interpreters; 2018 PYQ stem said **1808**, answer still Munro

rows: Also **Berar**, **East Punjab**, **Eastern Bengal**; assessed on land not crop; **20-30** yrs; **karanams** under Collector
==**Salem, Krishnagiri, Dharmapuri, Tiruvannamalai**==; after **Third Mysore War**
Mackenzie **Regulation VII of 1822**; Bird **Regulation IX of 1833**, survey-based

boxes.title: More terms
head: Term
Meaning
rows: Headmen lessees in Ceded Districts **1808** → ryotwari back c. **1820**
Held like estates after **1802**; many fell into arrears

boxes.title: Effects: added detail
items: Old zamindars' estates to ==**urban merchants, moneylenders**==; Haftam/Panjam let them seize tenants' property
Prices rose after **1800**; fixed demand gave Company nothing extra
Ryotwari: no land records, corrupt officials; vs Mughal **zabt** (**one-third**, **taccavi** loans)
==**American Civil War**== cotton slump → land to moneylenders; cash crops: indigo, cotton, opium, jute
